correctness.rationale: The one-card permutation representation yields E F_t=(n²-1)(1-a^t)/3 with a=1-2/n. F² lies in the ordered-pair matrix-coefficient module, decomposed as trivial, standard, [n-2,2], [n-2,1,1] with eigenvalues 1,a,a²,c (c=1-4/n). Uniform second moment and exact one- and two-step squared displacement determine the three coefficients algebraically; direct gap-sum identities for 3-cycles/disjoint transpositions are polynomial and were independently checked. Then variance = v+4(n²-1)(n+2)a^t/45 -(n+1)(3n³+9n²-4n+10)a^(2t)/90 +(n²-1)(n²-4)c^t/30. Positive slow mode dominates c and a², proving overshoot. Expansion c/a²=1-4/(n-2)² at t=floor(sn/2) cancels n⁴ terms and gives V(s)=[2+4e^-s-(6+3s)e^-2s]/45; V derivative has unique positive root 4e^s=9+6s. Independent finite transition laws verified n4..6 without assuming the mode formula.
